## A hint where to get the prices when ours are late

On 20 and 24 November 2026 the official German day-ahead prices reached us
hours late, and **Published prices missing** went red. Until now that was
all: the flag said something was wrong, but not what you could do about it.

Since 1.21.0 there is something you can do. Nord Pool and ENTSO-e usually
have the prices shortly after the auction, and an
[own price source](https://github.com/BackupBaTTerY/energypriceforecast-home-assistant#your-own-price-source-1210)
puts them in place of our forecast. So while the price for the slot running
now is only a forecast and no own source is set, Home Assistant now lists a
notice under **Settings > Repairs** that says where to set one.

- It goes away by itself once the official prices arrive or a source is set.
- One notice per configured market, so DK1 and DK2 each get their own.
- Not shown in the zones where we only pass on the forecast (NO1, NO3-NO5,
  SE1, SE2, FI, RO, SK, GR, BG, HR, GB and the Italian zones other than ITN):
  there the flag is on all the time, and a notice that never goes away would
  only teach you to ignore notices.
- Nothing is sent anywhere; the notice is worked out from the prices the
  integration fetches anyway.

The flag itself is unchanged, so automations built on it keep working.

**After updating, restart Home Assistant.** Reloading the integration is not
enough.
